en: Psalms 102

p.src: A Prayer of the afflicted, when he is overwhelmed and pours out his complaint before the LORD.

en: A Prayer of the afflicted, when he is overwhelmed and pours out his complaint before the LORD.
u.src: A Prayer of the afflicted, when he is overwhelmed and pours out his complaint before the LORD.

p.src: 1  Hear my prayer, LORD! Let my cry come to you.

en: Hear my prayer, LORD! Let my cry come to you.
u.src: 1  Hear my prayer, LORD! Let my cry come to you.

en: 102:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

p.src: 2  Don’t hide your face from me in the day of my distress. Turn your ear to me. Answer me quickly in the day when I call.

en: Don’t hide your face from me in the day of my distress. Turn your ear to me. Answer me quickly in the day when I call.
u.src: 2  Don’t hide your face from me in the day of my distress. Turn your ear to me. Answer me quickly in the day when I call.

p.src: 3  For my days consume away like smoke. My bones are burned as a torch.

en: For my days consume away like smoke. My bones are burned as a torch.
u.src: 3  For my days consume away like smoke. My bones are burned as a torch.

p.src: 4  My heart is blighted like grass, and withered, for I forget to eat my bread.

en: My heart is blighted like grass, and withered, for I forget to eat my bread.
u.src: 4  My heart is blighted like grass, and withered, for I forget to eat my bread.

p.src: 5  By reason of the voice of my groaning, my bones stick to my skin.

en: By reason of the voice of my groaning, my bones stick to my skin.
u.src: 5  By reason of the voice of my groaning, my bones stick to my skin.

p.src: 6  I am like a pelican of the wilderness. I have become as an owl of the waste places.

en: I am like a pelican of the wilderness. I have become as an owl of the waste places.
u.src: 6  I am like a pelican of the wilderness. I have become as an owl of the waste places.

p.src: 7  I watch, and have become like a sparrow that is alone on the housetop.

en: I watch, and have become like a sparrow that is alone on the housetop.
u.src: 7  I watch, and have become like a sparrow that is alone on the housetop.

p.src: 8  My enemies reproach me all day. Those who are mad at me use my name as a curse.

en: My enemies reproach me all day. Those who are mad at me use my name as a curse.
u.src: 8  My enemies reproach me all day. Those who are mad at me use my name as a curse.

p.src: 9  For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mixed my drink with tears,

en: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mixed my drink with tears,
u.src: 9  For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mixed my drink with tears,

p.src: 10  because of your indignation and your wrath; for you have taken me up and thrown me away.

en: because of your indignation and your wrath; for you have taken me up and thrown me away.
u.src: 10  because of your indignation and your wrath; for you have taken me up and thrown me away.

p.src: 11  My days are like a long shadow. I have withered like grass.

en: My days are like a long shadow. I have withered like grass.
u.src: 11  My days are like a long shadow. I have withered like grass.

p.src: 12  But you, LORD, will remain forever; your renown endures to all generations.

en: But you, LORD, will remain forever; your renown endures to all generations.
u.src: 12  But you, LORD, will remain forever; your renown endures to all generations.

p.src: 13  You will arise and have mercy on Zion, for it is time to have pity on her. Yes, the set time has come.

en: You will arise and have mercy on Zion, for it is time to have pity on her. Yes, the set time has come.
u.src: 13  You will arise and have mercy on Zion, for it is time to have pity on her. Yes, the set time has come.

p.src: 14  For your servants take pleasure in her stones, and have pity on her dust.

en: For your servants take pleasure in her stones, and have pity on her dust.
u.src: 14  For your servants take pleasure in her stones, and have pity on her dust.

p.src: 15  So the nations will fear the LORD’s name, all the kings of the earth your glory.

en: So the nations will fear the LORD’s name, all the kings of the earth your glory.
u.src: 15  So the nations will fear the LORD’s name, all the kings of the earth your glory.

p.src: 16  For the LORD has built up Zion. He has appeared in his glory.

en: For the LORD has built up Zion. He has appeared in his glory.
u.src: 16  For the LORD has built up Zion. He has appeared in his glory.

p.src: 17  He has responded to the prayer of the destitute, and has not despised their prayer.

en: He has responded to the prayer of the destitute, and has not despised their prayer.
u.src: 17  He has responded to the prayer of the destitute, and has not despised their prayer.

p.src: 18  This will be written for the generation to come. A people which will be created will praise the LORD,

en: This will be written for the generation to come. A people which will be created will praise the LORD,
u.src: 18  This will be written for the generation to come. A people which will be created will praise the LORD,

en: 102:18 Hebrew: יה Yah

p.src: 19  for he has looked down from the height of his sanctuary. From heaven, the LORD saw the earth,

en: for he has looked down from the height of his sanctuary. From heaven, the LORD saw the earth,
u.src: 19  for he has looked down from the height of his sanctuary. From heaven, the LORD saw the earth,

p.src: 20  to hear the groans of the prisoner, to free those who are condemned to death,

en: to hear the groans of the prisoner, to free those who are condemned to death,
u.src: 20  to hear the groans of the prisoner, to free those who are condemned to death,

p.src: 21  that men may declare the LORD’s name in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem,

en: that men may declare the LORD’s name in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem,
u.src: 21  that men may declare the LORD’s name in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem,

p.src: 22  when the peoples are gathered together, the kingdoms, to serve the LORD.

en: when the peoples are gathered together, the kingdoms, to serve the LORD.
u.src: 22  when the peoples are gathered together, the kingdoms, to serve the LORD.

p.src: 23  He weakened my strength along the course. He shortened my days.

en: He weakened my strength along the course. He shortened my days.
u.src: 23  He weakened my strength along the course. He shortened my days.

p.src: 24  I said, “My God, don’t take me away in the middle of my days. Your years are throughout all generations.

en: I said, “My God, don’t take me away in the middle of my days. Your years are throughout all generations.
u.src: 24  I said, “My God, don’t take me away in the middle of my days. Your years are throughout all generations.

p.src: 25  Of old, you laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the work of your hands.

en: Of old, you laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the work of your hands.
u.src: 25  Of old, you laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the work of your hands.

p.src: 26  They will perish, but you will endure. Yes, all of them will wear out like a garment. You will change them like a cloak, and they will be changed.

en: They will perish, but you will endure. Yes, all of them will wear out like a garment. You will change them like a cloak, and they will be changed.
u.src: 26  They will perish, but you will endure. Yes, all of them will wear out like a garment. You will change them like a cloak, and they will be changed.

p.src: 27  But you are the same. Your years will have no end.

en: But you are the same. Your years will have no end.
u.src: 27  But you are the same. Your years will have no end.

p.src: 28  The children of your servants will continue. Their offspring will be established before you.”

en: The children of your servants will continue. Their offspring will be established before you.”
u.src: 28  The children of your servants will continue. Their offspring will be established before you.”
